title: VA Housing Grants for Veterans - Home Accessibility Modifications

attrs.content: VA Housing Grants: Full Independence at Home

Veterans deserve homes that honor their service with full independence. One Source Mobility partners with VA programs to deliver certified, seamless accessibility modifications using grants like HISA, SAH, and SHA.

attrs.caption: Grants Unlock Your Accessible Home - We Handle the Rest.

attrs.content: Access funding tailored for service-connected disabilities—up to lifetime maximums for ramps, lifts, bathroom remodels, and more.
Up to $6,800 lifetime (service-connected) or $2,000 for others. Covers medically justified modifications like grab bars, widened doors, and ramps.
Home Improvements and Structural Alterations Grant for service-connected disabilities or 50%+ rating.
Up to $121,812 (FY2026 est.) for severe disabilities (e.g., loss of limbs, blindness). Funds new builds, major adaptations, or mortgage reductions.
Specially Adapted Housing Grant for veterans with qualifying severe service-connected disabilities.
Up to $24,565 (FY2026 est.) for mobility disabilities. Covers adaptations to existing homes, including roll-in showers and widened doorways.
Special Housing Adaptation Grant for veterans with service-connected disabilities affecting mobility.

attrs.values:
